title.narrative: Freedom of Expression and Media Viability: Ensuring Journalism as a common good

description.narrative: Freedom of expression is a fundamental human right that requires holistic action from different actors to ensure its protection. This includes global advocacy for press freedom; enhancing the safety of journalists online and offline; promoting freedom of expression in the digital environment and countering challenges arising from technological advancements and changes in how people worldwide seek, receive and impart information. Such actions embody the principles outlined in the Windhoek +30 Declaration on Information as a public good. Also, spearheading the global celebrations of the World Press Freedom Day, and the International Day for Universal Access to Information, UNESCO will continue and upscale its work to raise public awareness on freedom of expression and access to information. At the same time, specific activities will target rights holders, such as journalists, media outlets, media and human rights organizations, journalists’ unions, academic institutions, and civil society organizations, through knowledge generation, capacity-building, coalition building, and advocacy.
